newsitem.title: INDIA: Boat capsizes in Indian river, 40 missing -- agency.
newsitem.headline: Boat capsizes in Indian river, 40 missing -- agency.

text.p: At least 40 people are missing and feared dead after a crowded boat capsized in a rain-flooded river near India's border with Nepal, the Press Trust of India (PTI) news agency said on Monday.
It said the boat was travelling from Nepal to India on the Rapti river on Sunday night and quoted official sources as saying 30 of the 70 passengers swam ashore.
PTI said search operations had been hampered by incessant rain in the remote region in India's northern state of Uttar Pradesh. No further details were immediately available.
